items.prompt: At c=3, head=1 and tail=0, PUSH 9 is rejected. What are the final indexes?

options.why: The next write index would equal head, so the full rejection changes neither index.
Advancing tail on rejection would make a full ring look empty.
Moving head would silently discard an accepted value.
Rejection neither resets nor swaps the indexes.
